verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents some bulk actions: Managed Scans can bulk onboard and scan many repositories without CI changes, the `--autofix` flag applies rule-defined fixes across a codebase in one run, and a single scan covers a whole repo or monorepo. Bulk triage, though, is not documented: the AppSec Platform API only lists deployments, findings and projects, and the one community report of processing large result sets relied on an external SARIF-plus-LLM tool. Missing for 10: documented bulk triage/status updates on many findings at once, bulk write operations via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk onboarding.
